NULL JSFX

The NULL JSFX Android remotes: Remote for DAWs and Remote for Mixers. Free and open source (MIT), free forever. https://nulljsfx.tech

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://koulaxizis.github.io/null-jsfx-fdroid/repo
